experiment: Experiment 82.3.5 PS-SCAR — Prompt-guided Signed and Classifier-Aware Residual Learning
selection: Historical val=test. Strict test ACC improvement. Keep earliest tie.
preprocessing: Historical pre-CV RFE and scaling, transductive graph, train/test arrays unchanged.

class_statistics.estimation: Initialize with byte-exact E82.3 fit on legal E61 epoch10 training rows; explicit post-evaluation EMA follows below.

ema.compute: CPU float64 legal CAM projection using the original spectrum cache, then observed first and uncentered second moments.
ema.initialization: Start with E82.3 mean and stable inference variance exactly. Derive raw second moment from E82.3 unbiased variance times (n-1)/n plus squared mean.
ema.variance: Clamp roundoff in second minus mean squared at zero and apply n/(n-1) by class before E82.3 stabilization. Inference uses float32.
ema.order: Train, four optimizer steps, evaluate once and select Best with prior EMA, freeze Best if selected, update EMA once using captured legal eval CAM, persist post-update Latest.

feature_math.projection: Use the canonical historical U and exact historical whitened CAM in tokens and Gaussian LLR.
feature_math.class_attention: C_c = (1-N_c) A_c/(sum(A_c)+eps), in ASD=0 then TD=1 order. S=C_ASD-C_TD.
feature_math.signed_calibration: Freeze fold-specific P75 absolute S and bounded LLR over pooled directions and legal E61 epoch10 CAM. Floors 0.005 and 0.25. Fit the technical scales once on the medical initialized model and retain them in paired arms including a conditional anonymous arm.
feature_math.discriminative_evidence: s=tanh(S/tau_s), l=tanh(LLR/tau_l). D=R*(1-(N_ASD+N_TD)/2)*(alpha*s+(1-alpha)*l). Alpha is a bounded patient-by-direction 8->8->1 network with zero last affine at start.
feature_math.sensitivity: Evaluate current OutputLayer deterministically by composing only actual LayerNorm, Linear, GELU and Linear. Detach parameters, compute input J of gap ASD minus TD using autograd.grad, then stop gradient. p=J@U; p_norm=p/sqrt(sum(p^2)+1e-12).
feature_math.residual: g=tanh(clamp_min(MLP([LN(z), D, R, N_ASD, N_TD]),0)); last affine zero with PyTorch one-sided clamp derivative. r=g*D*p_norm. delta=historical smooth_limit(r@U.T,z) with 8% bound and zero protection rows. Original OutputLayer classifies z+delta.
feature_math.first_order: J dot delta = c*sum(g*D*p^2)/sqrt(sum(p^2)+1e-12) with nonnegative radial c. D alone controls a coordinate sign. Overall signs can cancel.
feature_math.evidence_off: Set D to zero at the fixed checkpoint. Together with gate-off and residual-off this restores native CAM144.

loss.semantic: Class-balanced NLL of the two normalized sums of class evidence, with eps pseudocounts. No separate inference head.
loss.gradient_protection: s=min(1,0.5*min_b ||g_cls,b||/(0.01||g_sem,b||+0.001||g_safe,b||+0.005||g_cf,b||+1e-12)); no cf term for G1. Apply precomputed auxiliary VJPs only to new parameter leaves.
loss.counterfactual: Balanced continuous hard-weighted T*[softplus((0.1-Delta)/T)-softplus(0.1/T)] plus mean high-margin weighted relu(-Delta)^2. Delta=m_on-m_off; both use the same dropout-free head, and off is detached.

decision.performance: 10/10 audited per arm; absolute ACC > 92.1891 and BA >= 92.0294; AUC/SEN deltas and positive aligned net corrections versus DARG.
decision.mechanism: Per arm: audited all folds, finite nonzero bounded Best CAM residual, nonzero upstream classification gradients, nonzero observed LLR sign overrides in conflict, nonzero actual deterministic logit gap change, and positive direct hard net. Always report wrong-DARG stratum.
decision.independent_medical_evidence: Paired chosen medical arm ACC > Anonymous, BA >= Anonymous and net corrections > 0. Treat fixed Best Query swap as an instantaneous diagnostic.
decision.low_margin_diagnostic: Report m_residual_off < 2, and Spearman correlation against continuous m_residual_off; neither is used for training or selecting a checkpoint.
decision.execute_anonymous: Exactly one 10-fold independent counterfactual Query control only if at least one medical arm meets both gates after all 20 are audited. Select highest mean ACC, then greatest direct net, then G1 on tie.
